title: 1 wounded as the Sampiano and Karim families trade fire in Calilangan, Balabagan
summary: A gunfight broke out between the Sampiano and Karim families in Barangay Calilangan, Balabagan, Lanao del Sur, a little after 1 p.m. on Sunday, 22 November 2026. PNP-BARMM spokesperson Capt. Steffi Salanguit said Andan Lim Maute, 26, of Poblacion, Balabagan, a member of the Sampiano family, was wounded in the exchange. Initial reports said the Karim family fired on the Sampiano group first. The police were monitoring the area.

sources.title: Isa sugatan sa bakbakan ng dalawang pamilya sa Balabagan, Lanao del Sur
